title: General Health
question: Would you say that in general your health is:

title: Number of Days Physical Health Not Good
section: Section 2.1 - Healthy Days — Health Related Quality of Life
question: Now thinking about your physical health, which includes physical illness and injury, for how many days during the past 30 days was your physical health not good?

title: Number of Days Mental Health Not Good
section: Section 2.2 - Healthy Days — Health Related Quality of Life
question: Now thinking about your mental health, which includes stress, depression, and problems with emotions, for how many days during the past 30 days was your mental health not good?

title: Poor Physical or Mental Health
section: Section 2.3 - Healthy Days — Health Related Quality of Life
question: During the past 30 days, for about how many days did poor physical or mental health keep you from doing your usual activities, such as self-care, work, or recreation?

title: Have any health care coverage
question: Do you have any kind of health care coverage, including health insurance, prepaid plans such as HMOs, or government plans such as Medicare, or Indian Health Service?

title: Multiple Health Care Professionals
question: Do you have one person you think of as your personal doctor or health care provider? (If "No" ask "Is there more than one or is there no person who you think of as your personal doctor or health care provider?".)

title: Could Not See Doctor Because of Cost
question: Was there a time in the past 12 months when you needed to see a doctor but could not because of cost?

title: Length of time since last routine checkup
question: About how long has it been since you last visited a doctor for a routine checkup?    [A routine checkup is a general physical exam, not an exam for a specific injury, illness, or condition.]

title: Ever Told Blood Pressure High
question: Have you EVER been told by a doctor, nurse or other health professional that you have high blood pressure? (If "Yes" and respondent is female, ask "Was this only when you were pregnant?".)

title: Currently Taking Blood Pressure Medication
question: Are you currently taking medicine for your high blood pressure?

title: Ever Had Blood Cholesterol Checked
question: Blood cholesterol is a fatty substance found in the blood. Have you EVER had your blood cholesterol checked?

title: How Long since Cholesterol Checked
question: About how long has it been since you last had your blood cholesterol checked?

title: Ever Told Blood Cholesterol High
question: Have you EVER been told by a doctor, nurse or other health professional that your blood cholesterol is high?

title: Ever Told Had Asthma
question: (Ever told) you had asthma?

title: Ever told) you had skin cancer?
question: (Ever told) you had skin cancer?

title: Ever told) you had any other types of cancer?
question: (Ever told) you had any other types of cancer?

title: Ever told) you have chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, emphysema or chronic bronchitis?
question: (Ever told) you have Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease or COPD, emphysema or chronic bronchitis?

title: Told Have Arthritis
question: (Ever told) you have some form of arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, lupus, or fibromyalgia? (Arthritis diagnoses include: rheumatism, polymyalgia rheumatica; osteoarthritis (not osteporosis); tendonitis, bursitis, bunion, tennis elbow; carpal tunnel syndrome, tarsal tunnel syndrome; joint infection, etc.)

title: Ever told you had a depressive disorder
question: (Ever told) you that you have a depressive disorder, including depression, major depression, dysthymia, or minor depression?

title: Ever told) you have kidney disease?
question: (Ever told) you have kidney disease? Do NOT include kidney stones, bladder infection or incontinence.(Incontinence is not being able to control urine flow.)

title: Ever told) you have diabetes
question: (Ever told) you have diabetes (If "Yes" and respondent is female, ask "Was this only when you were pregnant?". If Respondent says pre-diabetes or borderline diabetes, use response code 4.)

title: Respondents Sex
question: Indicate sex of respondent.
Are you: (marital status)

title: Education Level
question: What is the highest grade or year of school you completed?

title: Own or Rent Home
question: Do you own or rent your home? (Home is defined as the place where you live most of the time/the majority of the year.)

title: Are You A Veteran
question: Have you ever served on active duty in the United States Armed Forces, either in the regular military or in a National Guard or military reserve unit? (Active duty does not include training for the Reserves or National Guard, but DOES include activation, for example, for the Persian Gulf War.)

title: Employment Status
question: Are you currently...?

title: Number of Children in Household
question: How many children less than 18 years of age live in your household?

title: Income Level
question: Is your annual household income from all sources: (If respondent refuses at any income level, code "Refused.")

title: Internet use in the past 30 days?
question: Have you used the internet in the past 30 days?

title: Reported Weight in Pounds
question: About how much do you weigh without shoes? (If respondent answers in metrics, put a 9 in the first column)[Round fractions up.]

title: Reported Height in Feet and Inches
question: About how tall are you without shoes? (If respondent answers in metrics, put a 9 in the first column)[Round fractions down.]

title: Activity Limitation Due to Health Problems
question: Are you limited in any way in any activities because of physical, mental, or emotional problems?

title: Health Problems Requiring Special Equipment
question: Do you now have any health problem that requires you to use special equipment, such as a cane, a wheelchair, a special bed, or a special telephone? (Include occasional use or use in certain circumstances.)

title: Blind or Difficulty seeing
question: Are you blind or do you have serious difficulty seeing, even when wearing glasses?

title: Difficulty Concentrating or Remembering
question: Because of a physical, mental, or emotional condition, do you have serious difficulty concentrating, remembering, or making decisions?

title: Difficulty Walking or Climbing Stairs
question: Do you have serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs?

title: Difficulty Dressing or Bathing
question: Do you have difficulty dressing or bathing?

title: Difficulty Doing Errands Alone
question: Because of a physical, mental, or emotional condition, do you have difficulty doing errands alone such as visiting a doctor's office or shopping?

title: Smoked at Least 100 Cigarettes
question: Have you smoked at least 100 cigarettes in your entire life?    [Note: 5 packs = 100 cigarettes]

title: Frequency of Days Now Smoking
question: Do you now smoke cigarettes every day, some days, or not at all?

title: Interval Since Last Smoked
question: How long has it been since you last smoked a cigarette, even one or two puffs?

title: Use of Smokeless Tobacco Products
question: Do you currently use chewing tobacco, snuff, or snus every day, some days, or not at all? (Snus (Swedish for snuff) is a moist smokeless tobacco, usually sold in small pouches that are placed under the lip against the gum.)[Snus (rhymes with  goose )]

title: Days in past 30 had alcoholic beverage
question: During the past 30 days, how many days per week or per month did you have at least one drink of any alcoholic beverage such as beer, wine, a malt beverage or liquor?

title: Avg alcoholic drinks per day in past 30
question: One drink is equivalent to a 12-ounce beer, a 5-ounce glass of wine, or a drink with one shot of liquor. During the past 30 days, on the days when you drank, about how many drinks did you drink on the average? (A 40 ounce beer would count as 3 drinks, or a cocktail drink with 2 shots would count as 2 drinks.)

title: Binge Drinking
question: Considering all types of alcoholic beverages, how many times during the past 30 days did you have 5 or more drinks for men or 4 or more drinks for women on an occasion?

title: Most drinks on single occasion past 30 days
question: During the past 30 days, what is the largest number of drinks you had on any occasion?

title: How many times did you drink 100 percent PURE fruit juices?
question: During the past month, how many times per day, week or month did you drink 100 percent PURE fruit juices? Do not include fruit-flavored drinks with added sugar or fruit juice you made at home and added sugar to. Only include 100 percent juice.

title: How many times did you eat fruit?
question: During the past month, not counting juice, how many times per day, week, or month did you eat fruit? Count fresh, frozen, or canned fruit.(Read only if necessary: “Your best guess is fine. Include apples, bananas, applesauce, oranges, grape fruit, fruit salad, watermelon, cantaloupe or musk melon, papaya, lychees, star fruit,)

title: How many times did you eat beans or lentils?
question: During the past month, how many times per day, week, or month did you eat cooked or canned beans, such as refried, baked, black, garbanzo beans, beans in soup, soybeans, edamame, tofu or lentils. Do NOT include long green beans.(Read only if necessary: “Include round or oval beans or peas such as navy, pinto, split peas, cow peas, garbanzo beans, lentils, soy beans and tofu. Do NOT include long green beans such as string beans, broad or winged beans, or pole beans.”)

title: How many times did you eat dark green vegetables?
question: During the past month, how many times per day, week, or month did you eat dark green vegetables for example broccoli or dark leafy greens including romaine, chard, collard greens or spinach?

title: How many times did you eat orange-colored vegetables?
question: During the past month, how many times per day, week, or month did you eat orange-colored vegetables such as sweet potatoes, pumpkin, winter squash, or carrots? (Read only if needed: “Winter squash have hard, thick skins and deep yellow to orange flesh. They include acorn, buttercup, and spaghetti squash.”)

title: How many times did you eat OTHER vegetables?
question: Not counting what you just told me about, during the past month, about how many times per day, week, or month did you eat OTHER vegetables? Examples of other vegetables include tomatoes, tomato juice or V-8 juice, corn, eggplant, peas, lettuce, cabbage, and white potatoes that are not fried such as baked or mashed potatoes.(Read only if needed: “Do not count vegetables you have already counted and do not include fried potatoes.”)

title: Exercise in Past 30 Days
question: During the past month, other than your regular job, did you participate in any physical activities or exercises such as running, calisthenics, golf, gardening, or walking for exercise?

title: Type of Physical Activity
question: What type of physical activity or exercise did you spend the most time doing during the past month?

title: How Many Times Walking, Running, Jogging, or Swimming
question: How many times per week or per month did you take part in this activity during the past month?

title: Other Type of Physical Activity Giving Most Exercise During Past Month
question: What other type of physical activity gave you the next most exercise during the past month?

title: How Many Times Walking, Running, Jogging, or Swimming
question: How many times per week or per month did you take part in this activity during the past month?

title: How many times did you do physical activities or exercises to STRENGTHEN your muscles?
question: During the past month, how many times per week or per month did you do physical activities or exercises to STRENGTHEN your muscles? [Do NOT count aerobic activities like walking, running, or bicycling. Count activities using your own body weight like yoga, sit-ups or push-ups and those using weight machines, free weights, or elastic bands.]

title: Limited Because of Joint Symptoms
question: Are you now limited in any way in any of your usual activities because of arthritis or joint symptoms?

title: Does Arthritis Affect Whether You Work
question: Do arthritis or joint symptoms now affect whether you work, the type of work you do or the amount of work you do?

title: Social Activities Limited Because of Joint Symptoms
question: During the past 30 days, to what extent has your arthritis or joint symptoms interfered with your normal social activities, such as going shopping, to the movies, or to religious or social gatherings?

title: How Bad Was Joint Pain
question: Please think about the past 30 days, keeping in mind all of your joint pain or aching and whether or not you have taken medication. DURING THE PAST 30 DAYS, how bad was your joint pain ON AVERAGE? [Please answer on a scale of 0 to 10 where 0 is no pain or aching and 10 is pain or aching as bad as it can be.]

title: How often use seatbelts in car?
question: How often do you use seat belts when you drive or ride in a car? Would you say—

title: Adult flu shot/spray past 12 mos
question: During the past 12 months, have you had either a flu shot or a flu vaccine that was sprayed in your nose? (A new flu shot came out in 2011 that injects vaccine into the skin with a very small needle. It is called Fluzone Intradermal vaccine. This is also considered a flu shot.)

title: Where did you get your last flu shot/vaccine?
question: At what kind of place did you get your last flu shot/vaccine?

title: Pneumonia shot ever
question: A pneumonia shot or pneumococcal vaccine is usually given only once or twice in a person s lifetime and is different from the flu shot. Have you ever had a pneumonia shot?

title: Ever tested HIV
question: Have you ever been tested for HIV? Do not count tests you may have had as part of a blood donation. Include testing fluid from your mouth.

title: Location of last HIV test
question: Where did you have your last HIV test — at a private doctor or HMO office, at a counseling and testing site, in the emergency room, as an inpatient in a hospital, at a clinic, in a jail or prison, at a drug treatment facility, at home, or somewhere else?
During the past 30 days, did you provide regular care or assistance to a friend or family member who has a health problem or disability?
